Moderator: 
Ladies and gentlemen, good day, and welcome to the GTPL Hathway Limited Q2 FY27 
Earnings Conference Call, hosted by Emkay Global Financial Services Limited. As a reminder, 
all participant lines will be in the listen-only mode, and there will be an opportunity for you to 
ask questions after the presentation concludes. Should you need assistance during the conference 
call, please signal an operator by pressing star, then zero on your touchtone phone. Please note 
that this conference is being recorded. I now hand the conference over to Aryan Tripathi, Emkay 
Global Financial Services Limited. Thank you, and over to you, sir. 
Aryan Tripathi: 
Good evening, everyone. I would like to welcome the management and thank them for this 
opportunity. We have with us today Mr. Anirudhsinh Jadeja, Promoter and Managing Director; 
Mr. Piyush Pankaj, Chief Financial Officer; and Mr. Paramveer Jadeja, Chief Business Officer. 
Over to you, gentlemen. 
Anirudhsinh Jadeja: 
Thank you, Mr. Tripathi. Good evening, everyone, and a warm welcome to GTPL Hathway 
Limited earnings call to discuss our financial and operational performance for the second quarter 
FY27. During the first half of the year, we continued to focus on strengthening our presence in 
across digital TV and broadband businesses. 
Both segments remain integral -to-growth strategy, and our efforts are directed towards 
enhancing customer experience, strengthening our operating capability, and expanding reach 
across key markets. We have completed the acquisition of the ACT Group's cable TV business. 
In parallel, GTPL  Infinity, our HITS platform, launched in November 2025, continued to 
support our expansion and enable us to extend our reach through a scalable operating model. 
I will now hand over the call to our CFO, Mr. Piyush Pankaj, who will take you through the key 
operating highlights and financial performance of the company. 
Piyush Pankaj: 
Thank you, Mr. Jadeja. Good evening, everyone, and thank you for joining us for GTPL 
Hathway Limited's Q2 FY27 earnings call. Let me begin with the key operational highlights for 
the quarter. We successfully completed the acquisition of cable television business of seven 
companies belonging to the ACT Group on September 15, 2026, for an aggregate cash 
consideration of INR35.55 crores. 
As mentioned during our previous earnings call, this business has served approximately 6 lakh 
digital TV subscribers across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Odisha, and Karnataka. As we 
integrate these operations, we see opportunities to realize revenue synergies, optimize cost, and 
improve overall  operating efficiencies. 
Moving to our operational performance this quarter, starting with the digital TV business, our 
digital cable TV subscriber base as of September 30, 2026, stood at 11 million, addition of 1.5 
million in this quarter, of which 10.30 million were paying subscribers. The full impact of this

subscriber addition will realize in financials in subsequent quarter once we monetize the synergy 
benefits. 
Our business partner network comprised more than 51,000-plus partners, who continue to play 
an important role in strengthening our market reach and supporting customer acquisition and 
retention. Coming to our broadband business, our active subscriber base stood at 1.07 million at 
the end of quarter, which is 10,000 additions Q-o-Q, while broadband home pass reached 6 
million as of September 30, 2026. 
Broadband ARPU for Q2 FY27 stood at INR470, while average monthly data consumption per 
user was 436 GB. We have strengthened higher management in broadband. We have appointed 
new CEO, Mr. Vivek Raina, as broadband in for broadband business and other higher 
management appointments. 
We look forward that through the new branding of TrueFiber and aggressive market strategy, 
which will reap benefits in coming quarters for subscriber addition and positive financial impact. 
Our focus remains on improving subscriber conversion from our existing home pass, increasing 
broadband penetration within our digital TV customer base, and expanding our B2B business. 
 
Let me take you through our financial performance. Starting with the consolidated results, for 
Q2 FY27, consolidated total income stood at INR11,464 million compared with INR9,649 
million in Q2 FY26, translating into year-on-year growth of 19% and quarter-on-quarter growth 
of 12%. Subscription revenue stood at INR3,455 million compared with INR3,024 million in 
the corresponding quarter last year and INR2,913 million in Q1 FY27. Broadband revenue stood 
at INR1,459 million compared with INR1,393 million in Q2 FY26 and INR1,425 million in the 
previous quarter. 
 
Consolidated EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR1,103 million with reported EBITDA margin 
of 9.6%. The operational EBITDA margin stood at 20% this quarter. The consolidated PAT 
stands negative INR50 lakh in this quarter due to additional impact of INR75 million, which is 
INR45 million on account of forex loss and INR30 million amortization impact due to seven 
new transponders, which is in standalone financials. 
 
Moving to the standalone performance, total revenue for this quarter stood at INR8,003 million 
compared with INR6,402 million in Q2 FY26, representing year-on-year growth of 25% and 
quarter-on-quarter growth of 15%. Standalone subscription revenue stood at INR2,692 million 
compared with INR2,191 million in Q2 FY26 and INR2,127 million in Q1 FY27. EBITDA 
stood at INR667 million. 
 
With this, I conclude my opening remarks and would now request the moderator to open the 
floor for the Q&A session.
